historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes manual handling but its abbreviated evidence cannot prove stable identity, non-target preservation or clean controller/RAID state.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds exact drive/slot mapping, hot-swap/data boundaries, per-action evidence and recovery controls.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Slot-number and information rows verify mapping/inventory; this row specifically owns the physical insert/remove transition.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The literal source contains one insert and one remove; no extra cycle count is invented, and every approved action is independently evidenced.

original_test_intent: Verify an approved SAS/SATA HDD can be physically inserted into and removed from its backplane slot normally without unexpected system effects.
original_method: A qualified operator performs the approved insert and remove actions while the agent captures stable identity, controller, RAID, mount, health and OS/BMC evidence before and after each action.
manual_activity: User approves the exact target and safe handling plan; qualified operator inserts/removes the drive; agent captures complete pre/post evidence.
required_inputs: Supported SAS/SATA hot-swap or powered-down service procedure
Exact drive serial/WWN to slot/HBA/RAID mapping and final population
Qualified operator, ESD controls and physical/photo access
Secure OS/controller/BMC access and protected evidence storage
safety_requirements: Confirm the target is not an active boot, mounted, production or unsafe array member
Verify correct drive and slot before every physical action
Stop on damage, wrong enumeration, RAID rebuild/degrade, filesystem/media/thermal/power/BMC error or access loss
Preserve non-target and final population state
Do not power or manipulate the bay remotely or auto-rebuild an array
agent_execution_scope: Capture complete stable pre/post drive, HBA, RAID, mount and health inventory
Correlate operator action timestamps with OS/BMC events
Verify only the intended target changes
Do not handle hardware, claim physical proof, repair storage or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target, method, data boundary and recovery
Provide qualified operator and own physical recovery
Review insert/remove evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: lsblk and dmesg can corroborate enumeration, but a 30-line tail and unstable device names cannot prove the physical action or array safety.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture complete stable serial/WWN, HBA/controller, RAID/mount/health and full time-bounded OS/BMC logs immediately before and after each approved operator action.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: One insert and one remove, SAS/SATA scope and source 15/8 timing fields are preserved; no unsupported repeat count is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a timestamped pre/action/post transaction for the exact drive and slot, with independent physical and controller evidence plus final-state reconciliation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, storage-safety boundaries and recovery traceability without changing physical plug coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation observes state; qualified operator retains all hardware handling.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Removal can trigger rebuild or availability loss even when OS enumeration appears clean.

project_override_considerations: Project rules must define whether the exact bay is hot-swappable and whether the drive may be removed from its current RAID/mount state; generic SAS/SATA capability is insufficient.
expected_evidence: Approval, hot-swap support and target/final-state plan
Operator identity, timestamps and physical photos
Complete per-action inventory, RAID/mount/health and temperature evidence
Time-bounded dmesg/syslog/SEL/BMC records and command status
Final restored/approved population and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define SAS/SATA physical insert/remove; DeepSeek's repeated-cycle wording is not promoted beyond the literal source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operator, supported handling procedure and storage-safety inputs are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Converts abbreviated enumeration assistance into a stable-identity physical transition audit with RAID/data protections and final-state proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: A drive can disappear from lsblk while a controller is degraded, a rebuild begins or the wrong bay was touched. Valid coverage requires the operator's physical identity plus stable serial/WWN and controller/RAID state on both sides of each action, not a short log tail.
